requirement: Citizen creates a permit application with valid details
Application moves draft > submitted > paid > approved > issued
Illegal lifecycle transitions are refused
Officer must give a reason to reject
Only the right role can perform each action
Citizens cannot see or act on other citizens' applications
KRA PIN and business name are validated
M-Pesa payment: success / cancel / timeout / duplicate / wrong amount
KRA PIN check over SOAP incl. faults and timeouts
Issued certificate verifies; tampered / revoked / expired fail
Web journeys work on Chromium / Firefox / WebKit / mobile Chrome
test_ids: journeys.spec.ts (11 tests: full journey; reject; revoke; forged code; login and access control; KRA PIN error)

requirement: Portal meets load / stress / soak targets
Mobile app submits offline and syncs exactly once
Legacy records migrate with exact SQL reconciliation
Applications and state changes persist in the database (SQLite and PostgreSQL)
Users log in with email and password and receive a JWT; failures reveal nothing
Expired / forged / tampered / alg=none tokens and deactivated users are refused
Every create and transition is audited (actor / from / to / reason / time); refused actions leave no trace
Applications can be listed with state filter and pagination; citizens see only their own
Officers can revoke an issued permit with a reason; revocation is audited and cannot be repeated
Every portal page has zero serious or critical WCAG 2.1 AA violations and works by keyboard
test_ids: accessibility.spec.ts (6 tests incl. error and open-form states; keyboard-only login)

requirement: All API timestamps are UTC with an explicit offset on every database engine (regression for #13)
Credentials are never sent in a URL even if JavaScript fails (regression for #25)
Every response carries security headers (CSP without inline scripts / clickjacking / nosniff / permissions / COOP-COEP-CORP); API data is never cached (regression for #26)
